# Run lead's corrections to the glosser's output (aeneid-091)

Applied by `gloss_fix.py`:
- `flagrantis`: the glosser led with gen. sg. (with *matris*); at XII.65 it goes with *genas* (*flagrantis perfusa genas*), so acc. pl. now leads, gen. sg. kept as the other reading.
- `orithyia`: lemma `Orīthyia` → `Ōrīthyia` (Greek omega).
- `adscire`: lemma moved from `adscīscō` to `adsciō (asciō), -īre`, the verb Lewis & Short enter for this very line.
